outcome: High sensitive CRP (HsCRP) levels in cord blood
cohort: The study included 40 infants of mothers with gestational diabetes mellitus (IDM) and 43 infants whose mothers did not have diabetes.
finding: Infants of mothers with gestational diabetes had significantly lower adropin and pentraxin-3 levels and significantly higher HsCRP levels in cord blood, with myocardial hypertrophy negatively correlated with adropin.
cross-section timing: Cord blood samples taken at birth; echocardiographic measurements performed in the first three days of life.
